title: Model Availability → Customer Workflow Crosswalk and Competitive Impact Matrix
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Goal: Produce a practical crosswalk that maps third-party model availability (region, quantization variants, latency tiers) to specific customer workflows and surface a competitive impact matrix that scores where each model helps or hurts Redwood’s key use cases (embeddings pipelines, low-latency chat, batch summarization).
deliverables: Crosswalk spreadsheet (region x model x variant x workflow) with availability and expected perf bands
Competitive impact matrix: qualitative + numeric scoring for 6 priority workflows
One-pager summary for GTM highlighting 3 immediate risks and 4 mitigation levers
Deck for leadership with recommended triage (blocker / monitor / advantageous)
Open TODOs for engineering to validate perf assumptions (bench PRs)
acceptance_criteria: Crosswalk validated with infra and runtime teams (sign-off from ENG leads)
Impact matrix reviewed by two PMs and one Solutions Engineer
GTM one-pager accepted by Growth for messaging adjustments
Repository of raw signals (benchmarks, model release notes, provider status pages) linked in doc
success_metrics: Reduced time-to-triage for new model signals from 7 days to 48 hours
2 engineering tickets created for top-3 mitigations within 10 days of deliverable
GTM has concrete messaging adjustments for at least one vertical within cycle
tasks: Inventory models & variants (open-source release notes + vendor status) - owner: Marco
Map priority customer workflows (embeddings, low-latency chat, batch generative jobs) - owner: Aisha
Run lightweight perf probes (p95 latency, token cost estimators) for candidate region/variant combos - collaborator: ENG infra
Draft impact scoring rubric (latency, cost, deterministic output, compliance risk) - owner: Product
Circulate draft, collect feedback from Console, Dedicated, and Private owners - owner: Marco
Finalize crosswalk and produce GTM one-pager - owner: Aisha
